sentences.en: I'm Jenna Fisher.
sentences.zh: 我是珍娜·费舍尔。

sentences.en: And I'm Angela Kinsey.
sentences.zh: 我是安吉拉·金赛。

sentences.en: We were on The Office together.
sentences.zh: 我们曾一起出演《办公室》。

sentences.en: And we're best friends.
sentences.zh: 我们也是最好的朋友。

sentences.en: And now we're doing the Ultimate Office rewatch podcast just for you.
sentences.zh: 现在，我们专为您带来终极《办公室》重温播客。

sentences.en: Each week, we will break down an episode of The Office and give exclusive behind-the-scenes stories that only two people who were there can tell you.
sentences.zh: 每周，我们都会深度解析一集《办公室》，并分享只有身临其境的两人才能讲述的独家幕后故事。

sentences.en: We're The Office ladies.
sentences.zh: 我们是《办公室》女士。

sentences.en: Hello.
sentences.zh: 大家好。

sentences.en: Hey there, everybody.
sentences.zh: 嘿，各位。

sentences.en: We have such a fun show for you today.
sentences.zh: 今天我们为大家准备了一期非常有趣的节目。

sentences.en: We do.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: We got to interview Phyllis Smith all about her time on The Office.
sentences.zh: 我们采访了菲利斯·史密斯，聊了聊她在《办公室》的那段时光。

sentences.en: You know, a while back when we rewatched Phyllis's wedding, well, Phyllis sent in some great audio clips about that episode.
sentences.zh: 记得之前我们重温菲利斯的婚礼那一集时，菲利斯发来了一些关于那一集的精彩音频片段。

sentences.en: But we were so excited to finally have her on the podcast as a guest to do a full interview.
sentences.zh: 但我们一直很期待能邀请她作为嘉宾来播客做一次完整的访谈。

sentences.en: She told us how she got her role in The Office.
sentences.zh: 她告诉了我们她是如何得到《办公室》这个角色的。

sentences.en: It's such a fantastic story.
sentences.zh: 那真是一个精彩绝伦的故事。

sentences.en: I think it's maybe the best story of how someone got their job on The Office.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这可能是《办公室》所有演员入职经历中最棒的故事了。

sentences.en: Yeah, the best origin story.
sentences.zh: 没错，最棒的起源故事。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: We also asked her all of our usual questions, you know, and Angela made sure to ask her our call sheet questions,
sentences.zh: 我们还问了她所有常规问题，安吉拉还特意问了我们的通告单问题，

sentences.en: which are now one of my favorite things of our interviews.
sentences.zh: 这现在成了我最喜欢的访谈环节之一。

sentences.en: You just find out such interesting things about people.
sentences.zh: 你总能从中发现关于人们的有趣细节。

sentences.en: And, you know, one of the reasons I think I like it is because we know these people,
sentences.zh: 你知道，我觉得我喜欢它的原因之一是我们认识这些人，

sentences.en: and I feel like we've known them for so long.
sentences.zh: 而且我觉得我们认识他们太久了。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And then I learned something new.
sentences.zh: 然后我又了解到了新东西。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And we also get to talk to Phyllis about her new movie, Inside Out 2.
sentences.zh: 我们还和菲利斯聊了聊她的新电影《头脑特工队2》。

sentences.en: It's in theaters now.
sentences.zh: 现在正在影院上映。

sentences.en: My family loved the first Inside Out.
sentences.zh: 我的家人非常喜欢第一部《头脑特工队》。

sentences.en: We watched it so many times.
sentences.zh: 我们看了好多遍。

sentences.en: I can't wait to see this one.
sentences.zh: 我迫不及待想看这一部了。

sentences.en: Oh, same.
sentences.zh: 我也是。

sentences.en: My daughter has already clocked it.
sentences.zh: 我女儿已经把这事儿记在日程上了。

sentences.en: We have plans.
sentences.zh: 我们已经有计划了。

sentences.en: We're going to see it with her cousins.
sentences.zh: 我们要和她的表亲们一起去看。

sentences.en: Oh, so cute.
sentences.zh: 哦，太可爱了。

sentences.en: Like, it's going to be a family event movie for us.
sentences.zh: 对我们来说，这就像是一场家庭观影盛事。

sentences.en: Everybody knows the Inside Out movies, right?
sentences.zh: 大家都知道《头脑特工队》系列电影，对吧？

sentences.en: It's an animated movie.
sentences.zh: 这是一部动画电影。

sentences.en: It's from Pixar.
sentences.zh: 来自皮克斯。

sentences.en: So, in the first movie, there's a little girl.
sentences.zh: 在第一部电影里，有一个小女孩。

sentences.en: Her name is Riley, and she has to move to a new city.
sentences.zh: 她叫莱莉，她不得不搬到一个新的城市。

sentences.en: And in this process, we get to meet all the little emotions that are living in her head.
sentences.zh: 在这个过程中，我们见到了住在她脑海里的所有小情绪。

sentences.en: And they are voiced by different actors.
sentences.zh: 它们由不同的演员配音。

sentences.en: Like, there's joy.
sentences.zh: 比如，有乐乐。

sentences.en: That's kind of the leading emotion in her head.
sentences.zh: 她是她脑海里的主导情绪。

sentences.en: Joy is played by Amy Poehler.
sentences.zh: 乐乐由艾米·波勒配音。

sentences.en: But there's also all these other emotions.
sentences.zh: 但还有其他所有的情绪。

sentences.en: There's fear, anger, disguSt.
sentences.zh: 有怕怕、怒怒、厌厌。

sentences.en: There's sadness.
sentences.zh: 这里有忧忧。

sentences.en: And they kind of all come together to help Riley with this new transition.
sentences.zh: 它们齐心协力，帮助莱莉度过这个新的过渡期。

sentences.en: And Phyllis plays the voice of sadness.
sentences.zh: 菲利斯为忧忧配音。

sentences.en: She's so amazing in this role.
sentences.zh: 她在这一角色中的表现太棒了。

sentences.en: And she's back playing sadness for Inside Out 2.
sentences.zh: 她回归《头脑特工队2》，继续为忧忧配音。

sentences.en: I guess Riley is now a teenager, and she's going through puberty, which brings up a lot of new emotions.
sentences.zh: 我想莱莉现在是个青少年了，她正在经历青春期，这带来了许多新的情绪。

sentences.en: And Phyllis talks to us about what is so meaningful to her about these movies.
sentences.zh: 菲利斯跟我们聊了聊这些电影对她而言有何深意。

sentences.en: And it's just a really lovely interview.
sentences.zh: 这是一次非常棒的采访。

sentences.en: It really is.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: I thought that it went to some just really sweet places.
sentences.zh: 我觉得采访触及了一些非常暖心的话题。

sentences.en: And I think it's such a great representation of who Phyllis is as a person.
sentences.zh: 我认为这很好地展现了菲利斯本人的性格。

sentences.en: I'm really proud of it, actually.
sentences.zh: 说实话，我对此感到非常自豪。

sentences.en: I thought her recall of Office stuff was so good.
sentences.zh: 我觉得她对《办公室》的回忆太精彩了。

sentences.en: She remembers so much stuff.
sentences.zh: 她记得好多事情。

sentences.en: I know.
sentences.zh: 我知道。

sentences.en: I just loved reminiscing with her.
sentences.zh: 我特别喜欢和她一起追忆往事。

sentences.en: Me too.
sentences.zh: 我也是。

sentences.en: Well, you guys, why don't we take a break?
sentences.zh: 好了，各位，我们休息一下好吗？

sentences.en: And when we come back, it's our interview with Phyllis.
sentences.zh: 回来之后，就是我们对菲利斯的采访。

sentences.en: We made it.
sentences.zh: 我们做到了。

sentences.en: Woo-hoo!
sentences.zh: 呜呼！

sentences.en: I was going to start out being really sad for you.
sentences.zh: 我本来打算用忧忧的语气跟你打招呼的。

sentences.en: Oh, you were going to be sadness.
sentences.zh: 哦，你本来想扮演忧忧啊。

sentences.en: Yes, I was just going to say hi, guys.
sentences.zh: 是啊，我本来只想说，嘿，大家好。

sentences.en: How are you?
sentences.zh: 你们好吗？

sentences.en: I'm really happy to be here to talk to you all.
sentences.zh: 我很高兴能来这里和大家聊天。

sentences.en: So, it's a good day.
sentences.zh: 所以，今天真是美好的一天。

sentences.en: Oh, my gosh.
sentences.zh: 天哪。

sentences.en: I love it.
sentences.zh: 我太喜欢了。

sentences.en: Phyllis, Inside Out was such a huge hit in our family, the first one.
sentences.zh: 菲利斯，《头脑特工队》第一部在我们家大受欢迎。

sentences.en: I'm so excited there's going to be a second one.
sentences.zh: 我太激动了，居然会有第二部。

sentences.en: And it just tickles me so much that your voice is in this movie.
sentences.zh: 能听到你的声音出现在这部电影里，我真的特别开心。

sentences.en: Oh, I'll tell you.
sentences.zh: 哦，我跟你说。

sentences.en: I'm excited to see Inside Out 2 as well.
sentences.zh: 我也很期待看到《头脑特工队2》。

sentences.en: Phyllis, we watched it so many times.
sentences.zh: 菲利斯，我们看了好多遍。

sentences.en: It's one of the movies my kids have watched over and over.
sentences.zh: 这是我孩子们反复观看的电影之一。

sentences.en: Same.
sentences.zh: 我也是。

sentences.en: It's just so fantastic.
sentences.zh: 它真的太棒了。

sentences.en: Are your kids drawn to certain emotions more than others or just in general?
sentences.zh: 你的孩子们是更喜欢某种特定的情绪，还是整体都喜欢？

sentences.en: In general.
sentences.zh: 整体都喜欢。

sentences.en: In general.
sentences.zh: 整体都喜欢。

sentences.en: I think they like that there's this distinction between.
sentences.zh: 我觉得他们喜欢这种区分感。

sentences.en: I mean, that's what I like about it as a parent is that we get to see all the different emotions
sentences.zh: 我是说，作为家长，我喜欢它的一点就是我们能看到各种不同的情绪，

sentences.en: and then we get to see them work together.
sentences.zh: 然后看到它们如何协同工作。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: You know how I got this part was one of the producers on the show couldn't sleep one night
sentences.zh: 你知道我是怎么得到这个角色的吗？当时剧组的一位制片人有天晚上睡不着，

sentences.en: and he threw in Bad Teacher, which was Gene and...
sentences.zh: 于是他放了《坏老师》，那是吉恩和……

sentences.en: Lee's movie.
sentences.zh: 李的电影。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: That you did with Cameron Diaz.
sentences.zh: 就是你和卡梅隆·迪亚茨合作的那部。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And he couldn't sleep and he threw that DVD in and he immediately, when he heard my voice,
sentences.zh: 他当时睡不着，就放了那张DVD，结果一听到我的声音，

sentences.en: he called Pete Docter and said, I found our sadness.
sentences.zh: 他立刻给皮特·道格特打电话说，我找到我们的忧忧了。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: And so, yeah, it's interesting how things just kind of go from one project to another.
sentences.zh: 所以，确实，事情从一个项目延续到另一个项目，这种感觉很有趣。

sentences.en: Had I not done Bad Teacher, I wouldn't have been sadness, you know?
sentences.zh: 如果我没演《坏老师》，我就不会成为忧忧，你知道吗？

sentences.en: I had an acting teacher when I first was in Los Angeles who used to say, work begets work.
sentences.zh: 我刚到洛杉矶时有一位表演老师，他常说，工作会带来更多工作。

sentences.en: Take the job.
sentences.zh: 接下工作吧。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 绝对是这样。

sentences.en: Yeah, absolutely.
sentences.zh: 没错，绝对是。

sentences.en: Because you never know how it's going to connect to the next part of your life, you know?
sentences.zh: 因为你永远不知道它会如何与你人生的下一阶段产生联系，对吧？

sentences.en: So I was really, when I actually got the call for that movie for Inside Out 1, I was sitting
sentences.zh: 所以，当我真的接到那部电影《头脑特工队1》的电话时，我正坐在

sentences.en: here on our sofa and the phone rang and I didn't recognize the number and I answered it.
sentences.zh: 我们家的沙发上，电话响了，我不认识那个号码，但我还是接了。

sentences.en: It was the casting director, the Pixar casting director.
sentences.zh: 是选角导演，皮克斯的选角导演。

sentences.en: And they said, they'd like for you to come to Pixar to meet him.
sentences.zh: 他们说，他们想邀请我去皮克斯见见他。

sentences.en: And I went, okay.
sentences.zh: 我说，好的。

sentences.en: And so that was like in 2013, maybe.
sentences.zh: 那大概是2013年左右吧。

sentences.en: With Inside Out 1, I did about 10 different sessions in studios.
sentences.zh: 在《头脑特工队1》中，我在录音棚里录了大约10次。

sentences.en: All of them were in, most of them were at Disney on their studio and some up at Pixar.
sentences.zh: 大部分是在迪士尼的录音棚，有些是在皮克斯录的。

sentences.en: But unlike with Inside Out 2, because I'm not traveling, I did all of them here in St.
sentences.zh: 但与《头脑特工队2》不同的是，因为我不方便出差，我所有的录音都是在圣

sentences.en: Louis.
sentences.zh: 路易斯完成的。

sentences.en: They were kind enough to allow me to tape here in St.
sentences.zh: 他们很体贴，允许我在圣

sentences.en: Louis, so.
sentences.zh: 路易斯录音，所以。

sentences.en: That's so fantastic.
sentences.zh: 那真是太棒了。

sentences.en: You got to make your big star demand.
sentences.zh: 你终于提出了你的大牌要求。

sentences.en: Right?
sentences.zh: 对吧？

sentences.en: You're like, you can have me back as sadness, but only if you come to my town this time.
sentences.zh: 你就像是说，你们可以让我回归饰演忧忧，但前提是这次得来我的城市。

sentences.en: That's probably how you said it, right?
sentences.zh: 你当时一定是这么说的，对吧？

sentences.en: Yeah, there you go.
sentences.zh: 没错，就是这样。

sentences.en: I forgot about those big star demands.
sentences.zh: 我差点忘了那些大牌要求了。

sentences.en: Darn it, it's all too late now.
sentences.zh: 该死，现在说这些太晚了。

sentences.en: Well, had you ever done voiceover work like that before, Phyllis?
sentences.zh: 菲利斯，在那之前你做过类似的配音工作吗？

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 没有。

sentences.en: When I, my first session was at a Disney studio and I kept looking, this is so silly.
sentences.zh: 当我第一次在迪士尼录音棚录音时，我一直盯着看，这太傻了。

sentences.en: There was the music stand and there was a pencil there.
sentences.zh: 那里有个谱架，上面放着一支铅笔。

sentences.en: And I kept thinking, what do they want me to do with the pencil?
sentences.zh: 我一直在想，他们想让我用那支铅笔做什么？

sentences.en: Because I'd never done voiceover before.
sentences.zh: 因为我以前从没做过配音。

sentences.en: And the fact that they change it mid-sentence and you write it down.
sentences.zh: 而且他们会在句子中间修改台词，让你写下来。

sentences.en: I didn't know any of that.
sentences.zh: 这些我当时一无所知。

sentences.en: And so I was so bothered by the pencil lying there going, what am I supposed to do with it?
sentences.zh: 所以我一直被那支放在那里的铅笔困扰，心想，我该拿它怎么办？

sentences.en: I know I'm supposed to do something with it.
sentences.zh: 我知道我肯定得用它做点什么。

sentences.en: And then I found out later on in the session.
sentences.zh: 后来在录音过程中我才明白。

sentences.en: But I was fortunate enough then when Amy was hired, Amy and I did about maybe six sessions together.
sentences.zh: 但我很幸运，后来艾米加入后，我和她一起录了大概六次。

sentences.en: And it was kind of an on-site learning experience for me because I could watch her and learn to do it just on-site.
sentences.zh: 那对我来说是一次现场学习经历，因为我可以观察她，并现场学会怎么做。

sentences.en: I did it.
sentences.zh: 我做到了。

sentences.en: And so now it feels pretty comfortable and I like it.
sentences.zh: 所以现在我觉得很自在，也很喜欢这份工作。

sentences.en: Nice.
sentences.zh: 真不错。

sentences.en: I like to do more.
sentences.zh: 我很想多做一些。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: Well, Phyllis, thank you so much for coming on Office Ladies today.
sentences.zh: 菲利斯，非常感谢你今天能来参加《办公室女士》节目。

sentences.en: You have no idea how excited we are to get to interview you.
sentences.zh: 你不知道我们有多激动能采访你。

sentences.en: Yeah, I was, I was excited and also nervous for whatever reason.
sentences.zh: 是啊，我当时既兴奋又紧张，也不知道为什么。

sentences.en: Oh gosh, Phyllis.
sentences.zh: 天哪，菲利斯。

sentences.en: Where'd you stop it?
sentences.zh: 你停在哪儿了？

sentences.en: I was.
sentences.zh: 我当时是（紧张）。

sentences.en: It's just us gals.
sentences.zh: 这里只有我们几个姐妹。

sentences.en: I know these gals.
sentences.zh: 我认识这些姐妹。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: I mean, you're the reason we have our job.
sentences.zh: 我是说，我们能有这份工作全靠你。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: That's true.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: You know, speaking of work begets work and how you never know how one thing might come from another,
sentences.zh: 说到工作带来工作，以及你永远不知道一件事会如何引出另一件事，

sentences.en: will you tell our listeners how you got your job on the office?
sentences.zh: 你能告诉我们的听众你是怎么得到《办公室》这份工作的吗？

sentences.en: Oh, sure.
sentences.zh: 哦，当然可以。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 好。

sentences.en: I was the casting associate on the show.
sentences.zh: 我当时是这部剧的选角助理。

sentences.en: I'd been in casting about 19 years.
sentences.zh: 我从事选角工作大约19年了。

sentences.en: I was working with Allison Jones, the casting director.
sentences.zh: 我当时和选角导演艾莉森·琼斯一起工作。

sentences.en: And we were at the point in the casting process where we were pairing up the actors to see what their chemistry would be together and putting them on tape for the producers and also for the network.
sentences.zh: 当时我们正处于选角过程中的一个阶段，需要把演员们配对，看看他们在一起的化学反应如何，并把他们的表现录下来给制片人和电视网看。

sentences.en: Eventually, it was going to go to the network.
sentences.zh: 最终，这些录像要送到电视网去。

sentences.en: And I remember, and we were in this very odd building where the actors sat at one end and the auditions were at the other end.
sentences.zh: 我记得，当时我们在那栋很奇怪的楼里，演员们坐在这一头，试镜在另一头。

sentences.en: And I remember Kim Kloppis, the director, he was getting his coffee together and he turned around to me and he said, Phyllis, I want you to read the character of Pam today.
sentences.zh: 我记得导演金·克洛皮斯当时正在冲咖啡，他转过身对我说：“菲利斯，我希望你今天读一下帕姆这个角色。”

sentences.en: I went, what?
sentences.zh: 我当时想，什么？

sentences.en: And he said, I want you to read the character of Pam.
sentences.zh: 他说：“我希望你读一下帕姆这个角色。”

sentences.en: I went, okay.
sentences.zh: 我说，好吧。

sentences.en: Because at this point, the associate wasn't really reading with the actors.
sentences.zh: 因为在当时，助理通常是不和演员对戏的。

sentences.en: Like I said, they were pairing the Pam and the Jims and the Dwights and everybody together.
sentences.zh: 就像我说的，他们当时在把帕姆、吉姆、德怀特和其他人进行配对。

sentences.en: And I was a little taken back because I didn't want to step on like Allison Jones' toes.
sentences.zh: 我当时有点吃惊，因为我不想冒犯艾莉森·琼斯。

sentences.en: She was the boss.
sentences.zh: 她是老板。

sentences.en: I didn't know if they had cleared it with her or not, but I went ahead and did it.
sentences.zh: 我不知道他们是否征得了她的同意，但我还是照做了。

sentences.en: And I was so nervous, again, because I wanted to do a good job, not for me, but for the actors.
sentences.zh: 我当时非常紧张，还是那句话，因为我想做好，不是为了我自己，而是为了那些演员。

sentences.en: I wanted to make sure that I was right there when they needed me, timing-wise and such.
sentences.zh: 我想确保在他们需要的时候我能配合好，在节奏把握等方面不出错。

sentences.en: And one of the first pair, I was Pam and it was with Krasinski and another person who was going to audition for Dwight.
sentences.zh: 在第一组配对中，我扮演帕姆，对手是克拉辛斯基和另一个来试镜德怀特的演员。

sentences.en: And then eventually I played Dwight with two other people.
sentences.zh: 后来我还和另外两个人搭档演了德怀特。

sentences.en: And so no one ever, Greg Daniels or no one ever said to me, Phyllis, do you want to be in the show?
sentences.zh: 所以从来没有人，格雷格·丹尼尔斯或者其他人，从来没对我说过：“菲利斯，你想演这部剧吗？”

sentences.en: And I remember a fax came through to our office with an updated script and it had Phyllis in it.
sentences.zh: 我记得办公室收到了一份传真，上面有更新后的剧本，里面出现了“菲利斯”这个角色。

sentences.en: And Allison goes, is this Phyllis?
sentences.zh: 艾莉森问：“这是菲利斯吗？”

sentences.en: And I never heard anything.
sentences.zh: 我当时什么也没听到。

sentences.en: You know, she goes, is this Phyllis, my Phyllis?
sentences.zh: 你知道，她问：“这是菲利斯吗，我的那个菲利斯？”

sentences.en: But I never heard the answer.
sentences.zh: 但我从没听到过答案。

sentences.en: And then what happened was Wardrobe called.
sentences.zh: 后来发生的事是服装部打来了电话。

sentences.en: I had one line in the pilot, Wardrobe called and said, I understand you're playing the character of Phyllis.
sentences.zh: 我在试播集中有一句台词，服装部打电话来说：“我听说你要演菲利斯这个角色。”

sentences.en: And I said, yes, I am.
sentences.zh: 我说：“是的，我要演。”

sentences.en: Because I knew from the union rules that if Wardrobe called you or if you were sent a script, that constitutes a work call.
sentences.zh: 因为根据工会规定，如果服装部给你打电话或者你收到了剧本，那就构成了工作邀约。

sentences.en: And so when Wardrobe called, I knew it was to be.
sentences.zh: 所以当服装部打来电话时，我就知道这事成了。

sentences.en: And I said, yes.
sentences.zh: 我说，是的。

sentences.en: Phyllis, that is amazing.
sentences.zh: 菲利斯，这太神奇了。

sentences.en: That is so crazy.
sentences.zh: 这太疯狂了。

sentences.en: And you know what?
sentences.zh: 你知道吗？

sentences.en: We know from being on a set, half the time I found out things from my character from the costume department.
sentences.zh: 我们拍戏时都知道，我有一半时间都是从服装部那里了解到我角色的信息的。

sentences.en: And it's just so wild to me that the moment you realized you had a part was because Wardrobe called you.
sentences.zh: 对我来说，你意识到自己得到角色的那一刻竟然是因为服装部给你打电话，这太疯狂了。

sentences.en: Because Wardrobe called.
sentences.zh: 因为服装部打来了电话。

sentences.en: Yeah, exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错，就是这样。

sentences.en: And the other part of it was I was paid up on my dues.
sentences.zh: 另一部分原因是我当时已经交齐了会费。

sentences.en: 19 years earlier, I had done one SAG job here in St. Louis, got my SAG card, and I paid my dues every year.
sentences.zh: 19年前，我在圣路易斯做过一份演员工会的工作，拿到了工会卡，之后我每年都按时缴纳会费。

sentences.en: Not because I thought I was ever – I had thought this ship had sailed.
sentences.zh: 并不是因为我觉得自己还有机会——我当时以为这辈子都没戏了。

sentences.en: And it was my way of, like, contributing to the actors.
sentences.zh: 那只是我支持演员同行的一种方式。

sentences.en: So for 19 years, I paid my dues, and I was all paid up when I got the office job then.
sentences.zh: 所以这19年来我一直交着会费，当我得到那份办公室工作时，会费已经全部交清了。

sentences.en: You were ready.
sentences.zh: 你准备好了。

sentences.en: I was ready, yeah.
sentences.zh: 我准备好了，没错。

sentences.en: Oh, my gosh.
sentences.zh: 天哪。

sentences.en: So now you do the pilot.
sentences.zh: 所以现在你开始拍试播集了。

sentences.en: And it was so crazy for us, Phyllis, because we had been reading with you, like you said, all along.
sentences.zh: 菲利斯，这对我们来说太疯狂了，因为正如你所说，我们一直都在和你对戏。

sentences.en: Uh-huh.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: And then now we walk on set, and you are part of the caSt.
sentences.zh: 然后现在我们走进片场，你成了演员阵容的一员。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: I'll tell you, it was the strangest hiring in my estimation of having hired people for 19 years, but I didn't say no.
sentences.zh: 我跟你说，在我19年的招聘经历中，这绝对是最奇怪的一次录用，但我没法拒绝。

sentences.en: I've told the story before, Phyllis, that you are responsible for me getting my very first speaking job on television,
sentences.zh: 菲利斯，我以前讲过，是你让我得到了人生中第一个电视上的台词角色，

sentences.en: because you put my tape for Spin City at the top, and you told Allison, I think she should get it, and then I got it.
sentences.zh: 因为你把我试镜《城市大赢家》的录像带放在了最上面，还告诉艾莉森我觉得她应该得到这个角色，然后我就得到了。

sentences.en: And you got it, yes.
sentences.zh: 你确实得到了，没错。

sentences.en: Yeah, I remember meeting you, too.
sentences.zh: 是啊，我也记得我们第一次见面。

sentences.en: You came in.
sentences.zh: 你当时进来了。

sentences.en: It was also the one where Freaks and Geeks.
sentences.zh: 那也是《怪胎与书呆》试镜的时候。

sentences.en: Oh, yeah, I remember that when I came in to audition for Freaks and Geeks.
sentences.zh: 哦，对，我记得我去试镜《怪胎与书呆》的时候。

sentences.en: I didn't get it, but I remember.
sentences.zh: 我没选上，但我记得那次。

sentences.en: Yeah, you came in for that, and I met you there.
sentences.zh: 没错，你是为了那个角色来的，我在那儿见到了你。

sentences.en: She goes, Phyllis, this is Jenna Fisher from St. Louis.
sentences.zh: 她说，菲利斯，这是来自圣路易斯的珍娜·费舍。

sentences.en: And then, Angela, I remember when you were hired, we had a different casting session because we were creating the role, and I read with you that day as well.
sentences.zh: 然后，安吉拉，我记得你被录用的时候，我们进行了一次不同的选角会议，因为当时还在创作这个角色，那天我也和你对戏了。

sentences.en: Not only that day, but, Phyllis, the very first time I went in for all the producers, just a room full of people.
sentences.zh: 不仅是那天，菲利斯，我第一次去见所有制片人时，屋子里坐满了人。

sentences.en: They had a camera on a tripod.
sentences.zh: 他们架着一台三脚架摄像机。

sentences.en: You were reading the role of Michael.
sentences.zh: 你当时在读迈克尔的台词。

sentences.en: Michael, when Michael fake fires Pam to impress Ryan the temp, and I think it is my belief, Phyllis, and I've never really shared this, that the moment Pam calls Michael a jerk,
sentences.zh: 迈克尔，就是迈克尔为了给临时工瑞恩留下好印象而假装解雇帕姆的那场戏，我一直认为，菲利斯，我从未真正分享过这一点，就在帕姆叫迈克尔“混蛋”的那一刻，

sentences.en: right?
sentences.zh: 对吧？

sentences.en: I hit that word jerk so hard, probably because I'm a little Southern sometimes and feisty, and the room went quiet, and your reaction was kind of wounded for a split second.
sentences.zh: 我把“混蛋”那个词说得特别重，可能是因为我有时带点南方人的泼辣，屋子里顿时安静了下来，你那一瞬间的反应看起来有点受伤。

sentences.en: And I think that was the birth of Angela and Phyllis.
sentences.zh: 我觉得那就是安吉拉和菲利斯关系的开端。

sentences.en: I really do.
sentences.zh: 我真的这么认为。

sentences.en: Because then everyone erupted into laughter, and I remember thinking in my head, oh, wait, I don't think they're supposed to laugh right here.
sentences.zh: 因为随后大家都哄堂大笑，我记得当时心里想，哦，等等，我觉得他们不该在这里笑的。

sentences.en: I think this is supposed to be a sad moment.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这应该是一个悲伤的时刻。

sentences.en: It's interesting, isn't it, how your head goes through all of these exercises in a split second when you're auditioning, too, you know?
sentences.zh: 很有趣，不是吗？当你试镜时，大脑在瞬间经历了所有这些心理活动，你知道吗？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: It's crazy.
sentences.zh: 太疯狂了。

sentences.en: But I was so happy to see you when they brought me back in for The Accountant, you know, this role of, they didn't even have a name for her yet.
sentences.zh: 但当他们叫我回去试镜《会计师》这个角色时，看到你我真的很高兴，你知道，这个角色当时连名字都没有。

sentences.en: And I was like, oh, oh, that's who I read with last time.
sentences.zh: 我当时心想，哦，那不是我上次对戏的人吗？

sentences.en: That's Phyllis.
sentences.zh: 那是菲利斯。

sentences.en: Boy, we have a history, don't we, ladies?
sentences.zh: 天哪，我们真是有段历史了，不是吗，女士们？

sentences.en: We do.
sentences.zh: 确实。

sentences.en: We really do.
sentences.zh: 我们真的有。

sentences.en: I was just going to tell you, Phyllis, you know, Jenna and I are re-watching the show and seeing some of these episodes for the very first time since they aired, you know?
sentences.zh: 菲利斯，我正想跟你说，你知道吗，珍娜和我最近在重温这部剧，有些集数甚至是自播出以来我们第一次重看。

sentences.en: And we keep talking about characters we're falling back in love with, and Phyllis is hands down one of those characters.
sentences.zh: 我们一直在聊那些让我们重新爱上的角色，而菲利斯绝对是其中之一。

sentences.en: Everything you do on this show is brilliant.
sentences.zh: 你在剧中的每一个表现都非常精彩。

sentences.en: Every single line you say, every look you give, it should be like an actor's study class to watch you on this show.
sentences.zh: 你说的每一句台词，给出的每一个眼神，你在剧中的表演简直可以作为演员的教学案例。

sentences.en: Well, thank you.
sentences.zh: 噢，谢谢你。

sentences.en: I just went and tried to do it the beSt.
sentences.zh: 我只是尽我所能去演好它。

sentences.en: I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: I couldn't.
sentences.zh: 我做不到。

sentences.en: You know, I always had my sides there hidden underneath my.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我总是把剧本藏在我的……下面。

sentences.en: In your desk drawer, you would sometimes have them in that top drawer.
sentences.zh: 在你的办公桌抽屉里，你有时会把它们放在最上面的抽屉里。

sentences.en: Yeah, everybody would come and say, no, my sides were there and use them, too, you know.
sentences.zh: 是啊，大家都跑过来说，不，我的剧本在那儿，然后也用我的，你知道的。

sentences.en: I would.
sentences.zh: 我会的。

sentences.en: I was always losing mine, but I knew where yours were.
sentences.zh: 我总是弄丢自己的，但我知道你的在哪儿。

sentences.en: And you were welcome to use them, too.
sentences.zh: 而且我也很欢迎你用我的。

sentences.en: Phyllis, I have to ask you about your iconic Phyllis look.
sentences.zh: 菲利斯，我得问问你关于你那标志性的菲利斯造型。

sentences.en: As we've been re-watching the show, we have really noticed how characters have a certain wardrobe look.
sentences.zh: 在我们重温这部剧时，我们真的注意到每个角色都有特定的服装风格。

sentences.en: And Phyllis, the character, was in a lot of purple tones.
sentences.zh: 而菲利斯这个角色，穿了很多紫色调的衣服。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And with the big necklaces that were almost a character in and of themselves.
sentences.zh: 还有那些大项链，它们几乎本身就是一个角色了。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: I'm curious, did you have much input into this look when you met with Carrie Bennett for that first time?
sentences.zh: 我很好奇，你第一次见凯莉·贝内特时，对这个造型有什么建议吗？

sentences.en: How did this look come about?
sentences.zh: 这个造型是怎么定下来的？

sentences.en: No, because I was so fresh on the scene as an actor.
sentences.zh: 没有，因为那时我作为演员还是个新人。

sentences.en: I didn't know you could have input.
sentences.zh: 我不知道原来还可以提意见。

sentences.en: So I just went, stood there, let him put the clothes on me, made silly faces as they took the pictures.
sentences.zh: 所以我只是站在那儿，让他们给我穿上衣服，在拍照时做些傻表情。

sentences.en: I didn't want my arms to be flopping around.
sentences.zh: 我不希望我的手臂晃来晃去的。

sentences.en: I knew that.
sentences.zh: 我知道那点。

sentences.en: So I wanted my arms covered.
sentences.zh: 所以我希望把手臂遮住。

sentences.en: I didn't want him to look like I was landing planes in the office.
sentences.zh: 我不希望看起来像是在办公室里指挥飞机降落一样。

sentences.en: But that was about the only real parameter that I gave, was that I didn't want my arms to show.
sentences.zh: 但那大概是我提出的唯一真正的要求，就是我不希望露出手臂。

sentences.en: And the jewel tones just kind of came about, I guess, with my coloring and my eye color and stuff.
sentences.zh: 至于那些宝石色调，我想大概是根据我的肤色、眼睛颜色之类的自然形成的。

sentences.en: They just started developing the different necklaces.
sentences.zh: 他们开始设计各种不同的项链。

sentences.en: They actually made a lot of them to make them go with the outfits.
sentences.zh: 他们实际上制作了很多项链来搭配服装。

sentences.en: Did they really?
sentences.zh: 真的吗？

sentences.en: I didn't know that.
sentences.zh: 我不知道这一点。

sentences.en: Yeah, some of them, a lot were bought, but some were made or adjusted or two or three put together, you know.
sentences.zh: 是啊，有些是买的，但有些是制作的、调整过的，或者是把两三条拼在一起的，你知道的。

sentences.en: And so for me, it was always interesting.
sentences.zh: 所以对我来说，这总是很有趣。

sentences.en: We'd go in for a wardrobe fitting to see what we were actually going to be to wear, you know, what would be in our trailers to put on.
sentences.zh: 我们会去试装，看看我们到底要穿什么，你知道，看看拖车里会放什么衣服给我们穿。

sentences.en: Because some of the outfits that we started in the beginning were there, but a lot of them had changed just kind of miraculously.
sentences.zh: 因为我们刚开始穿的一些衣服还在，但很多衣服就像奇迹般地变了。

sentences.en: You would have a surprise.
sentences.zh: 你总会收获惊喜。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Well, it's funny you say that because, you know, on a lot of shows, most projects I've done, you do pick a full look and then that look ends up in your trailer.
sentences.zh: 你这么说很有趣，因为你知道，在很多剧组，我做过的绝大多数项目，你选好一套完整的造型，然后那套造型就会出现在你的拖车里。

sentences.en: But with the office, I felt like we were creating a closet of mix and match clothes.
sentences.zh: 但对于《办公室》，我觉得我们是在打造一个可以混搭的衣橱。

sentences.en: And so it's true.
sentences.zh: 所以这是真的。

sentences.en: I didn't know exactly which shirt and which blouse and which cardigan were going to be put together each week.
sentences.zh: 我不知道每周具体会把哪件衬衫、哪件上衣和哪件开衫搭配在一起。

sentences.en: Because they made a whole closet for our character, and it was very mix and match.
sentences.zh: 因为他们为我们的角色准备了一个完整的衣橱，而且非常适合混搭。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: I loved going into the costume trailer for our fittings.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢去服装拖车试装。

sentences.en: And if you walked in the back, every character had a whole row, like a whole row of clothes.
sentences.zh: 如果你走到后面，每个角色都有一整排，就像一整排的衣服。

sentences.en: So you could walk down the Dwight row of costumes, and it was mostly mustard-colored shirts.
sentences.zh: 所以你可以走过德怀特的服装区，那里大部分都是芥末色的衬衫。

sentences.en: But it was really interesting to see everyone's, like, row of clothes.
sentences.zh: 但看到每个人那一排排的衣服，真的很有意思。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: And you could actually, like you said, the character stood out by just the look.
sentences.zh: 而且正如你所说，光看造型就能看出角色的特点。

sentences.en: Yeah, they wouldn't even have to, yeah, they would not have had to have a label.
sentences.zh: 没错，根本不需要，真的，完全不需要贴标签。

sentences.en: You would know.
sentences.zh: 一眼就能看出来。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: You would know where Pam was and Angela and all of us, yeah.
sentences.zh: 你能一眼认出帕姆、安吉拉还有我们所有人在哪儿，没错。

sentences.en: And Meredith, poor Meredith.
sentences.zh: 还有梅雷迪思，可怜的梅雷迪思。

sentences.en: Kate.
sentences.zh: 凯特。

sentences.en: Kate did.
sentences.zh: 凯特演的。

sentences.zh: 她有一些非常特别的装扮。

sentences.en: Some crazy corduroy jumpers and sweater vests.
sentences.zh: 一些疯狂的灯芯绒背带裙和针织背心。

sentences.zh: 好吧，菲利斯，我们想问你一个问题，我一直很喜欢听

sentences.zh: 大家的回答，就是你在剧组期间，有没有最喜欢的剧集或场景，

sentences.zh: 或者关于菲利斯的故事线？

sentences.zh: 说到最喜欢的剧集，实在太多了，很难只选出一个。

sentences.zh: 我同意。

sentences.en: But, and a lot of bits and pieces from various episodes.
sentences.zh: 但是，还有很多来自不同剧集的片段。

sentences.zh: 比如，我喜欢吉姆在《赌场之夜》里在停车场告诉帕姆他爱她的那个场景。

sentences.en: on the parking lot.
sentences.zh: 那个场景总是，直到今天，依然让我哽咽。

sentences.en: That scene always, still to this day, it makes me get a lump in my throat.
sentences.zh: 然后当他走进来，把她揽入怀中时，那更是奇迹般的时刻，
